full_judgment: 10. The notice reads, amongst others, that respondent No.2 found that the petitioner sold products of Taka 46,33,55,612 during the period from January, 2003 to December, 2004 as per VAT accounts. But the petitioner received Taka 144,31,55,331 during the period on the basis of two bank accounts maintained with the Bank of Small Industry and Commerce Bangladesh Limited, Main Branch at Dhaka. On consideration of said transfers, said respondent was of the view that the petitioner evaded payment and/or adjustment of VAT to the extent of Taka 14,25,89,149.
